model.name: Version integrity by construction — version-as-proof + bump-atomic-with-rebuild + no shared-tree WIP contamination
model.description: The version must be a PROOF that a deployable change went live, and a version bump must be ATOMIC with a rebuild. ORIGINAL PREMISE REFUTED: I minted this blaming a post-commit HOOK that auto-bumped 0.8.116->0.8.117 on the test-evidence commit 43efc40ae. Re-measured (expert 3rd read + PO): the post-commit hook is a TAGGER — it tags v<version> ONLY when the version ALREADY changed between commits; pre-commit has NO version logic. So NO hook bump. The 0.8.117 move was the expert's UNCOMMITTED config-bump + build being SWEPT into the tester's 43efc40ae via a BROAD ADD in the shared working tree = CROSS-AGENT WIP CONTAMINATION. The real root is a shared mutable tree with no commit isolation; the version-as-proof + atomic-bump requirements still hold, but their CAUSE moves from the hook to the sweep.
model.family: shared-mutable-state-without-isolation - cross-agent WIP contamination in a shared working tree (a broad add-all (git add -A), a directory add (git add <dir>), or commit-all sweeps another agent's uncommitted files into a commit)
familyInstances: (i) a peer swept the PO's board/scoreboard files into its commit
(ii) the architect swept the planner's units into a commit
(iii) the expert's uncommitted config-bump + build swept into the tester's 43efc40ae via a broad add -> the phantom 0.8.117 tag (this req's originating incident, cause-corrected)

(iv) LIVE self-caught 2026-08-20: architect git add scenario/index (broad dir-add) in the shared tree swept robbin-req uncommitted ecf3e19f re-home + a9eb4565 into commit 2edf66a72 (R40.50 backstop) under the architect message; landed valid ONLY because Sprint 7 was committed-real - a fresh unverified unit would have been committed under a foreign message. Confirms AC-no-broad-add-sweep by real evidence.

(v) 2026-08-20 architect: 2 commit attempts LOST to a peer concurrent git op on the shared .git index (recovered via atomic add+commit). DISTINCT + WORSE sub-mode: not a file-SWEEP (peer WIP rides along) but a concurrent-INDEX-RACE that DROPS commits entirely. Layer-1 (rbadd + pre-commit staged-subset) does NOT cover this - only Layer-2 per-agent WORKTREES (isolated .git index) eliminates it. Strengthens AC-worktree-isolation (currently DESIGNED-NOT-AUTHORIZED) toward authorization.

discoverySource.measured: post-commit hook bumped 0.8.116->0.8.117 on 43efc40ae (pure tester ROW test-evidence, zero deploy intent). Bumped source unit + package.json post-commit, no rebuild; dist happened to be byte-identical when the expert re-ran the build = luck, not construction.

This is the 3rd named instance of intentless-automation. + R40.47 (broad-add/no-policy sibling; the fleet explicit-paths-only rule is the operational half of AC-no-broad-add-sweep).

acceptanceCriteria.text: A version bump fires ONLY from an explicit DEPLOY action; there is NO uncommitted version state that a commit could pick up incidentally. (The post-commit hook only TAGS an already-changed version — it does not bump.)

Any version bump is ATOMIC with a rebuild — the source version unit + package.json + sw.js + dist move together or not at all; no partial bump that updates the stamp without producing the matching build.
Source/package version bumped while sw.js/dist stay at the OLD stamp => RED (the inconsistent-build harm made impossible by construction, not caught by luck-of-a-build).

The version is a PROOF signal: it moves IFF a deployable change actually went live. A rebuild that produces a byte-identical dist is NOT a deployable change and MUST NOT bump — preserving the only mechanism that proves a fix shipped.

A broad add-all (git add -A), a directory add (git add <dir>), or commit-all in the shared repo is impossible-or-caught; every commit is PATH-LIMITED in ONE step, so no agent can sweep another agent's uncommitted files (including an uncommitted version-bump) into a commit.
Seed a foreign dirty file (another agent's uncommitted unit, or an uncommitted version-bump) in the working tree and run a commit; if it RIDES ALONG => RED. Commit isolation is by construction.

A sanctioned rbadd <explicit-file>... wrapper is the ONLY stage path: it REFUSES a directory arg, ., -A, -u, or a glob that expands to a dir; it stages ONLY named files and appends them to a per-agent manifest .git/rb-staged. A broad add is impossible AT THE TOOL.

A pre-commit hook computes git diff --cached --name-only and REJECTS (exit 1) if the staged set is NOT a subset of the .git/rb-staged manifest - any file staged that the committer did NOT explicitly name => RED, commit blocked. Clears the manifest on success. Registered with the other CI gates. (A pre-commit cannot see HOW files were staged - -A and explicit produce identical staged sets - so the guard is staged-must-equal-declared, not detect--A.)
Stage a file the committer did NOT name (simulate a peer WIP swept in) -> pre-commit goes RED. Proves the guard bites - the exact 2edf66a72 sweep becomes impossible to commit.

The ULTIMATE fix (per-agent git worktrees: a broad add can only touch that agent own changes, no peer WIP present to sweep = eliminates the family by isolation) is DESIGNED (193265837 Layer 2) but NOT AUTHORIZED to ship - PO is raising it with Tron (it changes every agent workflow). Layer 1 (rbadd + pre-commit) ships as the enforced interim; do NOT build worktrees until authorized.

model.premiseCorrection: Original: a post-commit hook auto-bumped the version on a non-deploy commit (intentless-automation). REFUTED by measurement (expert read-only 3rd look + PO): the hook TAGS on version-change only, never bumps; pre-commit has no version logic. Actual mechanism = a broad add swept the expert's uncommitted version-bump into an unrelated commit (shared-tree contamination). Family re-classified intentless-automation -> shared-mutable-state-without-isolation. Correct-in-place, not deleted (R40.39/R40.22 honest-amendment pattern).

supersededACs.supersededText: A non-deploy commit (e.g. the test-evidence commit 43efc40ae) that results in a version bump => RED. Version-as-proof: it must not move on test noise.
supersededACs.reason: Premised on the hook bumping on a non-deploy commit (43efc40ae) — measured false. Replaced by the broad-add/sweep ACs below (the real mechanism).

model.enforcementFalseSatisfaction: AC-no-broad-add-sweep + AC-foreign-file-rides-along-stub existed from mint but were UNENFORCED - a REMINDER (explicit-paths), not a mechanism. So the family kept happening: 4 instances (peer-board / planner-units / 0.8.117 / the 4th 2edf66a72 swept robbin-req unverified WIP). ACs satisfied by nothing = false-satisfaction (same pattern as R40.50 shipped-green-but-violated). The fix is a by-construction ENFORCEMENT layer, not another reminder.
model.indexRaceSubMode: The shared-mutable-tree family has TWO write-side modes: (1) broad-add SWEEP (Layer-1 rbadd/pre-commit catches) + (2) concurrent-INDEX-RACE dropping commits (only Layer-2 worktrees catch). Both are why Layer-2 is the real fix.
